output.scope_note: The paper is about structural modeling of an amorphous Li-based oxychloride solid electrolyte. It reports no new conductivity measurements, but its introduction quotes literature ionic conductivities for amorphous Li oxychloride electrolytes.

records.material_as_written: x Li2 O – MCly (M = Ta, Hf)
records.evidence_quote: The amorphous x Li2 O – MCly electrolytes (M = Ta, Hf) reach up to 6.6 mS/cm at 25 ◦C [3]
records.notes: Value quoted from Ref. [3] (Zhang et al., Nat. Commun. 2023), not measured here. It is 'up to' a maximum over a compositional family, so the specific composition is not identified. M is a framework cation, not a dopant. Material class set to halide because the material is an oxychloride.
